name: CrossoverMA
summary: This EA uses the MetaQuotes standard library CExpert framework to implement a moving average crossover strategy. It generates buy/sell signals based on a single SMA indicator via CSignalMA, uses no trailing stop, and manages risk with fixed lot sizing. The architecture is modular, delegating signal, trailing, and money management to separate plug-in objects.
summary_zh: 该EA使用MetaQuotes标准库CExpert框架实现均线交叉策略。它通过CSignalMA基于单一SMA指标生成买卖信号，不使用追踪止损，并采用固定手数进行资金管理。架构模块化，将信号、追踪止损和资金管理分别委托给独立的插件对象。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于移动平均线交叉，当价格从下方穿越SMA向上时产生买入信号，从上方穿越SMA向下时产生卖出信号。入场条件完全依赖CSignalMA模块的内部逻辑，该模块比较价格与SMA的关系来判断趋势方向。出场条件由CExpert框架的默认逻辑处理，由于使用了CTrailingNone（无追踪止损），出场完全依赖框架的反向信号或止损/止盈设置。仓位管理采用CMoneyFixedLot固定手数模式，每笔交易使用0.1手的固定交易量，同时设置了10%的资金百分比参数但固定手数模式下该参数作用有限。资金管理方面缺乏动态调整机制，不会根据账户余额或波动率自适应调整仓位大小。整体策略逻辑简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on moving average crossover, generating buy signals when price crosses above the SMA and sell signals when it crosses below. Entry conditions rely entirely on the CSignalMA module's internal logic, which compares price position relative to the SMA to determine trend direction. Exit conditions are handled by the CExpert framework's default logic; since CTrailingNone is used (no trailing stop), exits depend entirely on reverse signals or any stop-loss/take-profit set by the framework. Position sizing uses CMoneyFixedLot with a fixed 0.1 lot per trade, and while a 10% percent parameter is set, it has limited effect in fixed lot mode. Money management lacks dynamic adjustment mechanisms — there is no adaptive position sizing based on account balance or market volatility. The overall strategy is simple and direct, suitable for strongly trending markets, but prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy conditions.

pros: 基于MetaQuotes标准库CExpert框架，代码结构规范模块化，易于理解和扩展
使用CSignalMA信号模块，策略逻辑清晰简单，适合趋势跟踪交易
Expert_EveryTick设为false，仅在每根K线完成时执行，减少虚假信号和过度交易
魔法数字用于区分不同EA实例的交易，支持多EA并行运行
pros_en: Built on the MetaQuotes CExpert standard library, providing clean modular architecture that is easy to understand and extend
Uses CSignalMA signal module with clear and simple strategy logic, well-suited for trend following
Expert_EveryTick set to false means execution only on bar completion, reducing false signals and overtrading
Magic number distinguishes trades from different EA instances, supporting parallel EA operation
cons: 单一SMA指标策略在震荡市场中容易产生大量虚假信号导致连续亏损
使用CTrailingNone无追踪止损，无法锁定浮动利润，盈利交易可能回撤较大
固定手数资金管理无法根据账户余额和市场波动率动态调整仓位，风险控制能力有限
没有显式设置止损和止盈，出场完全依赖反向信号，可能导致单笔亏损过大
cons_en: Single SMA indicator strategy generates numerous false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
CTrailingNone means no trailing stop to lock in floating profits, winning trades may experience significant drawdowns
Fixed lot money management cannot dynamically adjust position size based on account balance or volatility, limiting risk control
No explicit stop-loss or take-profit settings; exits rely entirely on reverse signals, which may result in excessively large single-trade losses
improvements: 添加追踪止损模块（如CTrailingFixedPip或CTrailingMA）以锁定浮动利润，改善盈亏比
增加第二个不同周期的移动平均线形成双均线交叉确认，减少震荡市中的虚假信号
替换固定手数为动态仓位管理（如CMoneyFixedRisk），根据账户风险比例和止损距离自动计算手数
improvements_en: Add a trailing stop module (e.g., CTrailingFixedPip or CTrailingMA) to lock in floating profits and improve reward-to-risk ratio
Add a second moving average with a different period to form a dual-MA crossover confirmation, reducing false signals in ranging markets
Replace fixed lot sizing with dynamic money management (e.g., CMoneyFixedRisk) that calculates lot size based on account risk percentage and stop-loss distance

risk_points: 无追踪止损机制，盈利仓位无法动态保护，存在较大利润回撤风险
固定手数不根据账户规模调整，小账户可能过度杠杆，大账户资金利用率不足
无显式止损设置，单笔交易理论亏损无上限，极端行情可能造成重大损失
单一均线策略在震荡市中频繁开平仓，交易成本累积侵蚀利润
risk_points_en: No trailing stop mechanism means profitable positions lack dynamic protection, creating significant profit drawdown risk
Fixed lot size does not adapt to account size — small accounts may be overleveraged while large accounts are underutilized
No explicit stop-loss means single-trade theoretical loss is uncapped; extreme market conditions could cause major losses
Single MA strategy opens and closes positions frequently in ranging markets, with accumulated trading costs eroding profits
